rijksmuseumtwenthe.name: Rijksmuseum Twenthe
rijksmuseumtwenthe.slogan: Textile money turned into the East's finest art collection.
rijksmuseumtwenthe.line: Founded in 1927, when textile baron Jan Bernard van Heek gave his private collection and the building to the state.

plechelmus.name: St Plechelmus Basilica
plechelmus.slogan: Oldenzaal's grey tower has watched over Twente since the 1200s.
plechelmus.line: In the Middle Ages this church's chapter was one of only four outside Utrecht that could help elect the bishop of Utrecht.

singraven.name: Singraven Watermill
singraven.slogan: A Dinkel mill the Golden Age masters couldn't stop painting.
singraven.line: Jacob van Ruisdael and his pupil Meindert Hobbema both painted these watermills; Ruisdael's version hangs in London's National Gallery.

villamondriaan.name: Villa Mondriaan
villamondriaan.slogan: Where a teacher's son in Winterswijk learned to look at fields.
villamondriaan.line: Nature (or, that which I see) inspires me.
villamondriaan.by: Piet Mondrian, letter to H. P. Bremmer, 1914

synagogeenschede.name: Enschede Synagogue
synagogeenschede.slogan: Three brick domes that outlasted the war.
synagogeenschede.line: In the war local Jews hid its 19 Torah scrolls elsewhere, so the 1928 synagogue came through almost unscathed.
